title: Corinne K NDE 2211
content: I'm a registered nurse with asthma. I went to the emergency room the day after Christmas with an asthma attack. I was given numerous breathing treatments with no relief. My doctor arrived and told the staff to intubate me. As soon as they started to put the tube down my throat I heard one of them saying, 'She's coding'. All of a sudden, I was laying down in what felt like a hammock filled with cotton. I don't know how else to describe it. I felt like someone or something had their arms around me. It was the most comfortable, warm and loving feeling I have ever felt. Above me was the 'white light' it was bright like the sun, but it didn't hurt my eyes and it was warm. It was a peaceful, and I didn't hurt anymore. I wasn't afraid it was the safest I have ever felt in my life. They coded me for twelve minutes before they could get me back. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: December 26, 2004 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Very severe asthma attack. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I'm not sure, I was dead. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The brightness of the light, yet it didn't hurt my eyes. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A bright white light, but warm and it didn't hurt my eyes. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Calmness, love, peace beyond comprehension. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A conscious decision to 'return' to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Time is precious, less patience with what I call the bullshit of life. It's like I have a stopwatch inside of me and I hear it ticking. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The feelings and the type of light. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The loving and peaceful feeling. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I was in a coma for a three weeks afterward. I told my family as soon as I was able. My friends ask what dying is like and I tell them. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I've been a critical nurse for a long time. I've heard a few different things from different people that we were able to bring back. I don't think it affected my experience. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I accepted it to be real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It happened, I know it did. I don't question it. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt like "someone or something" had their arms around her; also reported a "definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin" (no further identification).

environment.environment_other_detail: Laying down in what felt like a hammock filled with cotton; above her was a warm bright white light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Very severe asthma attack; intubation attempted; heard staff say "She's coding"; coded for twelve minutes.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Felt held/embraced by an unknown presence while in a hammock-like cotton comfort; no tunnel; no deceased beings.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/separation with loss of body awareness, then immediate peaceful environment with warm white light; later a conscious decision to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described resting in a hammock filled with cotton and feeling physically embraced/held by an unknown presence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "She's coding"; "I was laying down in what felt like a hammock filled with cotton."; "It was the most comfortable, warm and loving feeling I have ever felt."; "Above me was the 'white light' it was bright like the sun, but it didn't hurt my eyes and it was warm."; "It's like I have a stopwatch inside of me and I hear it ticking."
